display.purpose: Hero headlines only; light weight so the hole can speak.

motion.name: ease-exit

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet companion to the primary pill.

narrative.overview: MELO’s marketing surface is a black field with one committed violet. The first viewport is a ray-traced accretion disk — not a screenshot of an app. Copy sits in the dark left (or the top on a phone). Violet is the action and the close, not a sprinkle of accents.
keyCharacteristics: Void black (#050014) as the page ground.
Violet as the only saturated hue: disk, marks, primary pills, waitlist field.
Geist light for display, Geist medium for section titles, Geist Mono only for tickers and the ledger.
Hairline white/10 rings, 16px plates, pill controls.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: If it is not black, white, or violet, it does not ship on this surface.

rules.name: The In-Hue Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is a dimmer violet-hot, not slate gray.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Display does not exceed ~4.35rem. Body stays near 1.125rem / 1.6.

dos: Put the black hole in the first viewport and keep copy off its busy half.
Label illustrative ledgers as demonstration data.
Use Geist Mono only for instruments (tickers, shares, emails).
Let one section be violet (the close).
donts: Invent waitlist counts, volume, or merchant contracts.
Use gradient text, numbered step cards, or kickers above section titles.
Introduce a second accent (emerald, blue, gold).
Set display type heavier than the picture.
